reponse: The results contain no salary offer to Yael Mizrahi. Discussion of numbers was deliberately postponed: the #hiring-sre reminder says no offer discussion with candidates until after the final round [3], and in the SRE hiring sync Maya Cohen and Shira Katz agreed to wait for the finals before talking numbers [4]. Yael only said she expects something "competitive with big tech" and gave no figure [4]. For context, the L5 Senior SRE band is 520–600k ILS base in Tel Aviv, $170–190k in New York, with offers above band needing CEO approval [2]. Her final round with Maya was scheduled for November 24, 2026 [1].
